project: Brain Finalize — Complete Missing Brain Implementation
description: Complete all critical missing gaps in the Brain system: BRAIN_MARGIN credits fix, Stripe agent-brain product creation, user brain access toggle, free plan gating, pending captures queue, SK backend, multi-mode search, agent brain cancel/grace period, and search feedback.

context.currentProblem: The Brain DB schema is fully in place (ns_* tables, RPCs, RLS) and the UI visualization is built. However the backend services for SK, multi-mode search, pending captures, and search feedback are completely missing. Brain ops charge 4x credits instead of 2x. The Stripe agent-brain product has never been created in live or test accounts so checkout fails. The user brain access toggle (per-agent) does not exist. Free plan has no brain guard. Agent brain cancel/deletion grace period is not implemented.
context.desiredState: Every brain feature listed in brain-integration.md is wired end-to-end. Brain ops cost 2x credits. Agents respect the user-brain-access toggle. Free users are blocked from brain. Pending captures queue gives users oversight of what enters their brain. SK ingestion lets users teach agent brains. Multi-mode search (semantic, hybrid, graph, chain, auto, summary) works. Agent brain cancel triggers a 14-day grace then deletes data.
context.architectureGoal: All ns_* tables already exist. Backend changes live in apps/api (user-facing) and apps/agent-api (agent-side). Frontend changes live in apps/web. No new DBs, no new env vars. Follow existing module/controller/service/repository pattern for each new vertical. Stripe add-on products must be created in BOTH live (AmY2Dy43Cs) and test (I08CkoZlhA) accounts before any checkout works.

userStories.title: Fix BRAIN_MARGIN to 2x in credits service
userStories.description: As the platform, brain AI operations should cost 2x credits (not 4x TEXT_MARGIN) so brain usage feels cheap and users ingest more, making agents smarter.
acceptanceCriteria: Add BRAIN_MARGIN = 2 constant to apps/agent-api/src/modules/billing/services/credits.service.ts
Brain embedding calls (feature: 'brain') use BRAIN_MARGIN not TEXT_MARGIN
Brain crystallization calls use BRAIN_MARGIN
TEXT_MARGIN = 4 still applies for all non-brain features
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: Currently chat.service.ts logs feature: 'brain' but credits.service.ts only has TEXT_MARGIN=4. Brain-specific operations in conversation-processing.service.ts and embedding.service.ts need to pass a separate margin. Look at how apiCost is passed to deductCredits and add an optional overrideMargin param, or add a dedicated deductBrainCredits method.

POST /api/brain/pending/:id/reject — marks capture as rejected
agent-api conversation-processing.service.ts submits to ns_pending_captures instead of saving directly to ns_snapshots

Change that to call a PendingCapturesService.submitPending() instead. The user-facing accept/reject endpoints in apps/api will move the approved snapshot data from pending into ns_snapshots.

userStories.title: Multi-mode search backend — hybrid, graph, chain, auto, summary
userStories.description: As the platform, brain search should support 6 modes: semantic (existing), hybrid, graph, chain, auto, summary — so agents and users find knowledge more effectively.
acceptanceCriteria: SearchService in apps/api/src/modules/brain/services/search.service.ts with mode dispatcher
hybrid mode: 70% semantic + 30% graph scores merged
graph mode: seeds from semantic, traverses traverse_edges RPC 2 hops
summary mode: uses search_snapshots_fts RPC for full-text search
chain mode: Gemini decomposes query into 2-3 sub-questions, runs parallel searches, merges with boost for snapshots appearing in multiple results
auto mode: Gemini selects best mode based on query analysis
GET /api/brain/search?q=...&mode=hybrid (default) works
Existing semantic search still works as mode=semantic
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: traverse_edges and search_snapshots_fts RPCs already exist in DB (migration 047). The existing search in memories.repository.ts uses search_ns_memories RPC for semantic. Build SearchService as a new service, new controller endpoint /api/brain/search. Reference apps/nexus/apps/neuralsnap/apps/app-backend/src/modules/search/services/search.service.ts

userStories.notes: ns_search_feedback table exists in DB. This is lower priority than the core search modes but should be added once the search endpoint exists. The boost logic can be simple: aggregate positive - negative ratings per snapshot_id, add as a score bonus in search result ranking.
